lesson: The host verify of ASKFLOOR-1-T3c FAILED: npm test has 47 regressions in 4 suites (channels/slack.test.ts, channels/teams/teams.test.ts, jobs/ipc-handler.test.ts, runtime/ipc-locked-permission-denial.test.ts) with one root cause — bindPendingPermissionInteractionMessage (pending-interaction-prompt-binding.ts:75) now calls active.repository.updatePendingInteractionPayload unconditionally to finalize the remember eligibility, so every existing prompt flow whose durability fake or backend has no such method (and whose members carry NO remember context) throws "Pending permission prompt binding could not be persisted" and 47 downstream expectations break. Do NOT guard with a typeof-function check on the repository (that is a shim); do NOT touch the four failing suites. Then run the FULL unit suite (npm test) and confirm 0 failures before reporting — the focused suites were green while the full suite was red. Keep all twelve leaves green; tsc, check:architecture, prettier.
